title: Amazon Leo to launch 40 satellites on its first Vulcan mission
summary: Amazon Project Kuiper to launch initial 40 broadband satellites on ULA Vulcan rocket
detailed: Amazon Leo plans to double its annual launch rate as it prepares for initial service rollout.
Career Choice is helping eligible Amazon employees earn certifications and launch new aerospace careers with Amazon Leo.
